name: WF-244 — Transaction Readiness → Title/Attorney/Funding/Broker Closing Coordination

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const transaction_status=String(d.transaction_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const closing_date=d.closing_date??null;const seller_name=String(d.seller_name??"").trim();const buyer_name=String(d.buyer_name??d.assignee_name??"").trim();const contacts=d.contacts&&typeof d.contacts==="object"?d.contacts:{};const required=["title","attorney","funding","broker"];const missing=required.filter(k=>!contacts[k]||!String(contacts[k]).trim());const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let status="needs_review",reason="Closing coordination requires review.",next="WF-126";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){status="blocked";reason="Missing lead, deal, or property identity.";}else if(blockers.length){status="blocked";reason="Unresolved transaction blockers prevent closing coordination.";}else if(!["transaction_ready","closing_ready"].includes(transaction_status)){status="transaction_not_ready";reason="Transaction readiness has not been confirmed.";}else if(!closing_date){status="incomplete";reason="Closing date is required.";}else if(!seller_name||!buyer_name){status="incomplete";reason="Seller and buyer/assignee identities are required.";}else if(missing.length){status="coordination_incomplete";reason="Required closing contacts are missing: "+missing.join(", ")+ ".";}else{status="coordination_ready";reason="Title, attorney, funding, and broker coordination inputs are complete.";next="WF-245";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-244",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,transaction_status,closing_date,seller_name,buyer_name,contacts,required_contacts:required,missing_contacts:missing,coordination_status:status,reason,requires_human_review:status!=="coordination_ready",next_workflow:next}}];
